sys_ui_message.message:
Clear the cache of the tables Data Source [sys_data_source] and Tables [sys_db_object].

To clear the cache:

  1. In the Run script text box of the background script page, enter the following script:

    GlideTableManager.invalidateTable('sys_data_source'); 
GlideCacheManager.flushTable('sys_data_source');
GlideTableManager.invalidateTable('sys_db_object'); 
GlideCacheManager.flushTable('sys_db_object');
  2. Select Run Script to run the background script in the global scope.
    The script may take several minutes to execute.
  3. After the script is executed successfully, select the application scope associated with the connector from the application picker.
